$comment: Dashboard layout — nav sections, pages and Overview widgets. Live copy: ~/.cowork/layout.json (override with COWORK_LAYOUT); when absent THIS file is served, so copy it there to customise. Hot-reloaded on save (refresh the page). Page types: dashboard (rows of widgets) and portal (cards from portal.json, optionally filtered by categories/keys) can be added under any id; app pages (chat, tasks, calendar, workflows, goals, routing, brains, personas, workers, config) keep their fixed id — omit one and it lands in a 'More' section, set hidden:true to drop it from the nav. Widgets: sysbar {tiles: cpu|gpu|memory|thermal, hideUnavailable}, stats {items: workers|openTasks|personas|failedTasks|waitingInput|scheduled|uptime}, dispatcher, activity {limit}, platforms, services {keys|categories, compact}, note {text (markdown)}, quality {days (1-365)}, rulings {days (1-365), limit (1-100)}; every widget also takes title and span (1-4). A row is a widget list or {minWidth, widgets}. See docs/dashboard.md#layout.
